warnings: SEES functions (by body), tables (by existence), columns (by name and type family), policies (by existence, on public and storage schemas). STILL CANNOT SEE: grants, indexes, constraints, triggers, views, enum types, extensions, RLS enable/force state, a policy's own USING/WITH CHECK expression, a column's DEFAULT or NULLABILITY, or a migration whose whole content is a grant/update/backfill with no schema trace. There is no applied-migrations ledger in this project to compare against: supabase_migrations.schema_migrations does not exist.

dimensions.method: replay create/drop function/table/policy in file and statement order; compare function bodies against pg_get_functiondef, tables/columns/policies by existence

canary.id: a function name, a column and a policy name no migration could have created must each be reported ABSENT
